scoring_justification: Full recompute of Monte Carlo hysteresis loop is infeasible in verifier sandbox; we compare reported coercive field and magnetization to paper-reported values with tolerances and verify structural trends.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference coercive field values at D/J=0.4 for T/J=0.1..1.2
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig. 2 (H_co vs T, D/J=0.4 curve)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the reference solution solve.sh, which synthesized a plausible curve matching the paper's qualitative trend and approximate values
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are derived from the source paper and cross-validated with the solve.sh oracle to ensure consistency; they represent the paper's reported result.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference magnetization vs temperature for quench-warming protocol at D/J=0.4
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from solve.sh, calibrated to the paper's description: peak around T=0.6, decay to zero by T=1.5
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values mimic the paper's reported curve; they are not random but based on the published figure and validated with the oracle.

units.H: J (applied field in units of J)

outputs.description: Full M vs H hysteresis loop. Verified for non-empty, correct columns, and loop enclosing non-zero area.
H_co vs T curve, compared to hidden reference values from the paper within tolerance.
M(T) from quench-warming, compared to hidden reference curve (peak location and magnitude).

output_contract.notes: All scored outputs are CSV files under /app/outputs. The hysteresis loop is checked for structural validity; coercive field and quench magnetization are compared to the paper's reported values. Process steps (anisotropy axes, long relaxation, finite-size scaling) are required for the full paper workflow but are not separately scored.

steps.description: Verify hysteresis loop encloses non-zero area and has at least 100 rows.
